# Every Pokémon: source-backed balance assessment

Recommendations only. Main setting: Enhanced typing/stats, abilities enabled. Stats are in HP / Attack / Defense / Speed / Sp. Atk / Sp. Def order. Full move sources do not imply instant access at every point in the campaign.

[Read methodology and priorities](README.md) · [Searchable report](index.html)

## Abomasnow — Keep (priority 3)

`ABOMASNOW` · Grass/Ice · 90/92/75/60/92/85 · BST 494 · Individual design assessment

Snow Warning, Ice priority, mixed 92 offenses and Grass/Ice support give a weather niche despite difficult weaknesses. Thick Fat is a separate build that does not summon hail. Keep stats initially; improve team support and acquisition before inflating numbers. Weather setters need not independently sweep to earn a slot.

**Abilities:** 1. Snow Warning; 2. Soundproof; hidden. Thick Fat. One active ability at a time.

**Type-only matchups:** Fire ×4, Water ×0.5, Electric ×0.5, Grass ×0.5, Fighting ×2, Poison ×2, Ground ×0.5, Flying ×2, Bug ×2, Rock ×2, Steel ×2.

**Original stats/types:** 90/92/75/60/92/85; Grass/Ice. These settings are independent.

**Evolution:** No further evolution. **Growth:** Slow.

**Own level-up:** 1: Ice Punch; 1: Leer; 1: Powder Snow; 1: Razor Leaf; 7: Icy Wind; 13: Swagger; 14: Bullet Seed; 19: Ice Shard; 22: Leech Seed; 25: Avalanche; 28: Seed Bomb; 28: Giga Drain; 30: Swords Dance; 37: Mist; 40: Freeze-Dry; 41: Icicle Crash; 45: Blizzard; 52: Wood Hammer; 58: Leaf Storm.

**TM/HM/elemental tutor compatibility:** TM03: Curse; TM06: Toxic; TM10: Hidden Power; TM11: Sunny Day; TM14: Blizzard; TM15: Hyper Beam; TM16: Icicle Crash; TM17: Protect; TM19: Energy Ball; TM21: Facade; TM22: Solar Beam; TM27: Return; TM32: Swagger; TM33: Ice Punch; TM44: Rest; TM45: Attract; TM54: Weather Ball; HM04: Strength; Tutor: Ice Beam.

**Egg tutor/breeding:** Double-Edge, Growth, Leaf Storm, Magical Leaf, Skull Bash, Stomp. **Utility/special tutors:** Light Screen, Sleep Talk, Substitute.

**Pre-evolution moves available by retention:** Attract, Curse, Double-Edge, Energy Ball, Facade, Growth, Hidden Power, Ice Beam, Light Screen, Magical Leaf, Protect, Rest, Return, Skull Bash, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Stomp, Substitute, Sunny Day, Toxic, Weather Ball.

- **Snow Warning (slot 1):** Summons hailstorm when switched in. Setter, Speed and recovery abilities are separate alternatives. Team/weather access determines the actual combination. Candidates: Blizzard, Protect, Weather Ball.

- **Soundproof (slot 2):** Gives immunity to sound-based moves.

- **Thick Fat (slot 3):** Ups resistance to Fire and Ice.

**Setup:** Swords Dance.

**Priority attacks:** Ice Shard.

**Control:** Toxic.

**Field/pivot/disruption:** Leech Seed.

**Mapped wild evidence:** Ice Path 1F — Grass / Cave, lv 39 (Day); Ice Path 1F — Grass / Cave, lv 39 (Morning); Ice Path B1F — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Day); Ice Path B1F — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Morning); Ice Path B1F — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Night); Ice Path B2F Blackthorn Side — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Day); Ice Path B2F Blackthorn Side — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Night); Ice Path B2F Blackthorn Side — Grass / Cave, lv 41 (Morning); Ice Path B2F Mahogany Side — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Day); Ice Path B2F Mahogany Side — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Morning); Ice Path B2F Mahogany Side — Grass / Cave, lv 40 (Night); Ice Path B3F — Grass / Cave, lv 42 (Day); Ice Path B3F — Grass / Cave, lv 42 (Morning); Ice Path B3F — Grass / Cave, lv 42 (Night)

## Abra — Keep (priority 3)

`ABRA` · Psychic · 25/20/15/90/105/55 · BST 310 · Source-based progression assessment

Retain this 310-BST special-leaning progression stage. Its current ability choices and Psychic typing must be assessed at its obtainable level, before evolving into Kadabra. Relevant own-list milestones: Teleport at 1. Evolution route: dbbw EVOLVE_LEVEL, 16, KADABRA. No independent stat or typing buff is proposed from source inspection. Check its own timing and retained moves when changing the family; evolution should remain its principal long-term reward.

**Abilities:** 1. Magic Guard; 2. Synchronize; hidden. Inner Focus. One active ability at a time.

**Type-only matchups:** Fighting ×0.5, Psychic ×0.5, Bug ×2, Ghost ×2, Dark ×2.

**Original stats/types:** 25/20/15/90/105/55; Psychic. These settings are independent.

**Evolution:** dbbw EVOLVE_LEVEL, 16, KADABRA. **Growth:** Medium Slow.

**Own level-up:** 1: Teleport.

**TM/HM/elemental tutor compatibility:** TM01: Drain Punch; TM02: Headbutt; TM03: Curse; TM06: Toxic; TM07: Zap Cannon; TM10: Hidden Power; TM11: Sunny Day; TM17: Protect; TM18: Rain Dance; TM21: Facade; TM27: Return; TM29: Psychic; TM30: Shadow Ball; TM32: Swagger; TM33: Ice Punch; TM35: Knock Off; TM41: Thunder Punch; TM44: Rest; TM45: Attract; TM46: Thief; TM48: Fire Punch; TM52: Zen Headbutt; HM05: Flash.

**Egg tutor/breeding:** Light Screen, Encore, Barrier, Skill Swap, Psych Up. **Utility/special tutors:** Light Screen, Reflect, Sleep Talk, Substitute, Thunder Wave.

**Pre-evolution moves available by retention:** None.

- **Magic Guard (slot 1):** Only takes damage from attacks. These are complementary tools, not additional ability effects. Item, HP, switch and stage conditions must be tested. Candidates: Encore, Facade, Protect, Substitute.

- **Synchronize (slot 2):** Passes Psn, Par, or Brn to foes.

- **Inner Focus (slot 3):** Protects it from flinching.

**Control:** Thunder Wave, Toxic.

**Field/pivot/disruption:** Encore, Teleport.

130 Speed with Dragon Dance, hazards and Roost is already generous. Rock Head or Strong Jaw change damage routes but do not stack. - **Rock Head (slot 1):** Protects it from recoil damage. Candidates: Brave Bird, Take Down.

**Direct recovery/Wish:** Roost.

## Girafarig — Reassign ability (priority 2)

`GIRAFARIG` · Normal/Psychic · 70/80/65/85/90/65 · BST 455 · Individual design assessment

The listed pool lacks the usual strong self-dropping attacks that make Contrary attractive. Replace slot-two Contrary with Early Bird, retaining Inner Focus/Sap Sipper and stats. This improves coherent utility without adding another setup abuse route, while Farigiraf keeps Armor Tail as its evolved signature. Preserve any intentionally designed inverse-Curse set only if playtesting shows a valued niche.

## Omastar — Watch (priority 2)

`OMASTAR` · Rock/Water · 70/60/125/55/115/70 · BST 495 · Individual design assessment

## Pikachu — Keep (priority 3)

`PIKACHU` · Electric · 35/65/40/90/60/50 · BST 340 · Individual design assessment

Light Ball changes Pikachu's effective offenses dramatically, so evaluate that item before buffing Attack 65 or Sp. Atk 60. Preserve low HP and distinct Electric utility. Raichu/Gorochu provide the natural upgrade path, while an item-reliant Pikachu can remain a frail alternative. Do not make it both bulky and Light Ball boosted.

**Abilities:** 1. Static; 2. Lightning Rod; hidden. Galvanize. One active ability at a time.

**Type-only matchups:** Electric ×0.5, Ground ×2, Flying ×0.5, Steel ×0.5.

**Original stats/types:** 35/55/40/90/50/50; Electric. These settings are independent.

**Own level-up:** 1: Charm; 1: Growl; 1: Nasty Plot; 1: Sweet Kiss; 1: Tail Whip; 1: Thunder Shock; 4: Quick Attack; 7: Thunder Wave; 8: Nuzzle; 11: Double Kick; 19: Spark; 21: Double Team; 23: Slam; 26: Thunderbolt; 28: Iron Tail; 29: Agility; 33: Wild Charge; 36: Light Screen; 39: Thunder; 45: Volt Tackle.

**Pre-evolution moves available by retention:** Attract, Curse, Disarming Voice, Double Slap, Encore, Facade, Fake Out, Flash, Fly, Headbutt, Hidden Power, Iron Head, Mud-Slap, Protect, Rain Dance, Reflect, Rest, Return, Reversal, Rock Tomb, Sleep Talk, Substitute, Surf, Swagger, Swift, Toxic, Wish, Zap Cannon.

- **Lightning Rod (slot 2):** Electric moves boost Sp.Atk.

## Shuckle — Keep (priority 3)

`SHUCKLE` · Bug/Rock · 20/10/230/5/10/230 · BST 505 · Individual design assessment

Sticky Web and Stealth Rock with Sturdy already create a lead niche independent of its tiny offenses. Contrary Shell Smash is defensive, not a normal sweeping boost. Keep stats and restricted damage. Do not buff Attack or HP to match its 505 BST; low HP and passivity are the balancing costs of enormous defenses.

**Abilities:** 1. Sturdy; 2. Gluttony; hidden. Contrary. One active ability at a time.

**Type-only matchups:** Normal ×0.5, Water ×2, Poison ×0.5, Rock ×2, Steel ×2.

**Original stats/types:** 20/10/230/5/10/230; Bug/Rock. These settings are independent.

- **Sturdy (slot 1):** Cannot be knocked out with one hit.

- **Gluttony (slot 2):** Eats a held Berry earlier.

## Sneasler — Nerf move chance (priority 2)

## Tentacruel — Keep (priority 3)

`TENTACRUEL` · Water/Poison · 80/70/65/100/80/120 · BST 515 · Individual design assessment

100 Speed, 120 Sp. Def, Rapid Spin, Toxic Spikes, Flip Turn and Scald give it a full utility role. Merciless can punish poison but competes with Rain Dish/Clear Body. No stat buff is needed.
